product.name: cortex
promise: A knowledge store that keeps itself current.
product.lede: cortex spins up knowledge instances on the Epistemic Knowledge Runtime (EKR). One spec file defines an instance: its seed schema, its model settings and its data sources. systemd timers run each source on its schedule, a model extracts what new or changed documents say, and EKR applies it to the instance's own SQLite store, which you browse with ekr view or serve to agents over MCP.
product.meta: Rust command line · Linux with systemd user units · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

sections.title: A store per instance, fed on a schedule.
sections.lede: cortex owns the instance lifecycle and the runs. EKR owns the store and its schema, Connectors owns every integration and every credential, and the model only reads text and answers in EKR's extraction format.

items.title: Defined by one spec file
items.description: Name, description, the pinned EKR version, the seed schema, the model and its per-run budget, the sources and their schedules: one cortex.instance/1 YAML file.

items.title: Three kinds of source
items.description: Web search or listed sites through a Connectors websearch adapter, the records of any Connectors operation, or local files matching a glob.

items.title: Only what is new or changed
items.description: A run keeps documents it has not applied or whose text changed, extracts them in batches within the run's budget, and applies the result to the store.

items.title: No secret enters cortex
items.description: A source names a Connectors connection id. Connectors signs every call; cortex never reads, stores or passes a credential.

sections.title: From a timer to the store.
sections.lede: What one scheduled run of one source does.

steps.label: systemd
steps.title: Timer fires
steps.description: The source's timer runs cortex run <instance>/<source> --record-failure.

steps.label: Connectors or files
steps.title: Fetch
steps.description: Web pages and operation records through Connectors, or local files, become documents; credential shapes are masked.

steps.label: cortex
steps.title: Keep new or changed
steps.description: Against the source's seen state, at most max_documents_per_run of them.

steps.label: model
steps.title: Extract
steps.description: An isolated claude -p call per batch answers an EKR extraction document.

steps.label: EKR
steps.title: Apply
steps.description: ekr apply-extraction commits it to the instance's SQLite store.
